evidence: Platform-side correlation job (hops job deploy) ran the Hopsworks SDK against the leakage_analysis feature group and computed Pearson correlations between each feature and the binary label. f2 had an absolute correlation of 0.992393, far above all other features (f1: 0.047, f3: 0.072, f4: 0.068, f5: 0.021, f6: 0.049). Mean of f2 for label=0 is -0.002 (normal) vs 2.500 for label=1, a separation of 2.5 standard deviations — confirming f2 was computed from post-outcome data.
